description: Read EXIF tags, including GPS, or strip them. action is read or strip. scope is all or gps. gps-only removal keeps the other JPEG tags. Other formats are re-encoded, which drops every tag. Send base64 or a public URL. Private addresses are refused and the decoded file is capped at 10 MB.

file.description: The photo. Provide url or data.

data.description: Base64 bytes or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB.

filename.description: File name, including the extension when you have one.

mimeType.description: MIME type when you know it.

url.description: Public http or https URL. Private and local addresses are refused.

scope.description: Used when action is strip. gps removes the GPS block from a JPEG. all re-encodes and drops every tag.

name: read_exif

data.description: Cleaned image as base64. Empty when action is read.

title: Read or strip photo metadata
